validityNotice.classification: Development pilot with known adapter and operational defects

issues.detail: R0 omitted the shared validation/user-evidence adapter, causing valid proposals and derived calculations to be penalized for missing provenance. Original generations and scores are retained; this is not evidence that the production baseline cannot make those proposals.

Both query backend fields were exposed in one grammar. Wren repeatedly selected custom plans that the backend gate correctly rejected. A later development version exposes only the permitted backend schema and actual typed Wren columns.

Three early route requests expired during manual-to-continuous dispatcher transition. These are harness errors, not established provider outages. The continuously logged319requests all returnedHTTP200.

validityNotice.interpretation: Complete unchanged data proves measurement coverage/integrity only. These known defects make this pilot unsuitable for selecting an architecture. No held-out questions were used to make the fixes.

selectionStatus: KNOWN STUDY DEFECTS / NOT FOR SELECTION

timingUsage.policy: An explicit usage input must contain all provider attempt records for these episodes. Unmatched runs/setup records are excluded.

definitions.relevance: Binary required-document IDs from the independent reference; exact versions are distinct IDs. No graded relevance labels are invented.
definitions.conditionalRetrieval: Only document-applicable episodes with recorded completed retrieval output. Explicit empty output after a requested search scores zero; unknown error stages and skipped searches are excluded and counted separately.
definitions.rankMetrics: Recall@6 = distinct relevant hits / required documents. MRR@6 uses the first relevant rank, with0 if none in6. nDCG@6 uses binary gains and ideal ordering of up to6 required documents. R3 managed raw ranking metrics are unavailable.
definitions.managedCoverage: R3 selected-document coverage measures the authorized documents selected through provider citations, not raw managed search recall or rank quality.
definitions.endToEnd: Fraction of all recorded document-applicable episodes that released an unblocked result whose actual authorized evidence included every required document. Errors and blocked outcomes count as failed delivery, without assigning unknown retrieval stages a zero retrieval score.
definitions.taxonomy: Multi-label observed conditions, not mutually exclusive causes. Structured fact mismatch may include semantic key, currency, entity, period or schema mismatch; it is not automatically an arithmetic error.
definitions.latency: Nearest-rank p50/p95 for all attempts and separately non-error outcomes (including blocks). Harness wall includes pacing/queue waits. Complete HTTP totals require durations for every provider attempt in the explicit per-call usage snapshot. Partial known subtotals have separate percentiles; entirely unknown or unverified legacy aggregates are excluded. No-call episodes are disclosed separately. Provider sums are not production latency.

limitations: Descriptive supplemental metrics on synthetic documents; no confidence intervals, causal claims, human citation-entailment judgments or publication-grade power are implied.
Conditional retrieval results can be selected by planner decisions and upstream failures. Read them alongside skipped/unknown counts and end-to-end delivery.
Required-document labels identify a reference evidence set, not an exhaustive set of every possibly relevant document.
An absent final episode record is not an observed failure. Compare these measured denominators with the main run manifest for planned/missing episodes.
Repeated episodes and paraphrases are clustered. Scenario-macro recall is also shown; no episode independence is assumed.
The current runner may discard intermediate state after an exception. Unknown-stage errors cannot diagnose retrieval quality.
